scenes.title: An answer with visible steps
scenes.viewerPurpose: Expose missing justification beneath fluent answers; Identify a common language for explicit reasoning steps as the proposal; Explain circuits as operations and dependencies
scenes.composition: Hold a fluent answer beside an empty space where its reasoning steps should be. Introduce a proposed common notation connecting input, operation and conclusion. Follow one small chain of operations in order, using ordinary readable labels.

scenes.title: What a summary must preserve
scenes.viewerPurpose: Ask which details simplification must preserve; Use average and median as a concrete lost distinction; Connect the example to reusable reasoning
scenes.composition: Show the original values beside a smaller retained record, leaving the next question open. Retain sum and count to answer an average, then leave the median unanswered. Keep the lost ordering visible beside the reusable average procedure.

scenes.title: Follow the missing distinction
scenes.viewerPurpose: Keep unfinished problems and assumptions visible; Follow what an answer must justify
